title: Even recursive NAND as iterated tribes
statement: For every natural number $k$ and every sign assignment $x$ to the $2^{2k}$ coordinates, the recursive NAND of depth $2k$ equals the iterated tribes function of depth $k$ on the assignment reindexed by the canonical bijection from the $2^{2k}$ coordinates to the $4^k$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a sign to each of the $2^{2k}$ coordinates
